entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A white-furred, one-eyed leonin planeswalker from Naya who travels to Theros searching for his friend Elspeth.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A human planeswalker and Ajani's friend who left Dominaria for Mirrodin; Ajani suspects she is the latest Champion of the Sun on Theros.

entities.name: Seza
entities.description: A young gray-furred female leonin patrol leader with a large axe who escorts Ajani to Tethmos.

entities.name: Aletha
entities.description: A taller, quiet female leonin warrior in Seza's patrol.

entities.name: Koila
entities.description: A mottled golden-furred leonin with a notched scar above her nose, raised in the wilds and recently come to Tethmos.

entities.name: Brimaz
entities.description: The young, tall leonin king of Oreskos, chosen successor of the late Queen Omala, and an old friend of Ajani.

entities.name: Omala
entities.description: The former leonin queen who died in battle with humans.

entities.name: Lanathos
entities.description: A scarred older human storyteller living among the leonin who tells the tale of the Champion of the Sun.

entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: A massive fifty-headed celestial hydra bound by the gods, who in the story awakens and is slain by the Champion of the Sun.

entities.name: Champion of the Sun
entities.description: A title Heliod gives a worthy mortal in times of great need; the latest champion slew Polukranos near Meletis.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker who manipulated the religious and political development of Alara's shards.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The foremost god of Theros's humans, who blesses the Champion of the Sun.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A god of Theros whose fury knocked Polukranos from the stars and who forged the Champion's spear in the story.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: A god of Theros who with Heliod bound Polukranos beneath the earth.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: A tyrant said in the tale to have been vanquished on the Plateau of the Four Winds.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane protected by powerful gods, whose skies now show a blank void.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Ajani's home shard-plane of Alara, now merged with the other four.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The world formed from five merged shard-planes, one of which was Naya.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal world that other planeswalkers say is dead, with Phyrexia returned.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invaders who have returned to Mirrodin.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane Elspeth left for Mirrodin.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: The mostly nomadic cat-folk of Oreskos, led by King Brimaz, who dislike Theros's human gods.

entities.name: Oreskos
entities.description: The leonin homeland on Theros.

entities.name: Tethmos
entities.description: The largest leonin den on Theros and seat of King Brimaz.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The human city that once enslaved the leonin, whom they consider their true homeland.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A city besieged by a horde of minotaurs where the Champion was reportedly seen.

entities.name: Moat of Oblivion
entities.description: A void in the sky where no star shines, appearing days earlier during the Silence of the gods.

entities.name: Silence of Kruphix
entities.description: A period when the gods fell silent and are said to have gone away from mortals.

entities.name: Theriad
entities.description: The collection of stories about the Champion of the Sun.

entities.name: Minotaurs
entities.description: Raiders ranging more widely and in greater numbers than before and besieging Akros.

events.summary: Ajani travels across Theros, reflecting on gods and on Naya, and camps in the mountains hoping leonin will find him.
events.quote: He made camp in the fading light, without stealth or subterfuge.

events.summary: Ajani notices the night sky lacks its usual constellations and has a void where no star shines.
events.quote: Worse, in one corner of the sky, there was simply blankness, a void where no star shone.

events.summary: Ajani recalls that Elspeth left Dominaria for Mirrodin, which other planeswalkers now say is dead with Phyrexia returned.
events.quote: Then other Planeswalkers had spread the word: Mirrodin is dead. Phyrexia has returned.

events.summary: Seza's patrol finds Ajani at dawn and recognizes him.
events.quote: You are Seza," said Ajani, yawning, "and the last time I was here, you were too young to go out on patrol."

events.summary: Seza reveals that Brimaz is now king after Queen Omala died fighting humans, and that he declined vengeance.
events.quote: The queen, Omala, had died in battle with humans.

events.summary: Seza tells Ajani the gods vanished, leaving a ring of blank sky called the Moat of Oblivion.
events.quote: One day, the gods just... went away.

events.summary: Ajani reaches Tethmos and is reunited with Brimaz, who jokes about his title.
events.quote: Brimaz snorted, and soon the two leonin were chortling and embracing.

events.summary: Ajani asks Brimaz for help finding his friend Elspeth, and Brimaz points him to Lanathos.
events.quote: You should talk to Lanathos," said Brimaz.

events.summary: Lanathos tells the leonin the tale of Polukranos and the Champion of the Sun, who slays the hydra at the Plateau of the Four Winds.
events.quote: Polukranos, eater of poleis, beloved of the gods, was no more.

events.summary: Ajani introduces himself to Lanathos and asks about Elspeth; Lanathos eagerly asks where Ajani is from.
events.quote: There are people across the mountains? Leonin and human?

events.summary: Lanathos explains that the Champion of the Sun is a title, and that the latest champion killed Polukranos about a month ago.
events.quote: Very recently. During the Silence of the gods. A month ago, perhaps slightly more.

events.summary: Ajani realizes the latest Champion may be Elspeth, and Lanathos says she was seen at Akros, besieged by minotaurs.
events.quote: After she slew Polukranos, the Champion was spotted at Akros, which has been besieged by a horde of minotaurs.

events.summary: Ajani resolves to find Elspeth and help her.
events.quote: After all, the Champion always has companions.

relations.note: Friends; he searches for her on Theros.
relations.quote: I'm here looking for a friend of mine, a human," said Ajani. "Her name is Elspeth."

relations.note: Old friends; Ajani once counseled him on coexistence with humans.
relations.quote: Ajani had spent long hours in conversation with the young man about the importance of coexistence with humankind.

relations.note: He is the successor chosen by the late queen.
relations.quote: Brimaz, her chosen successor, declined to seek vengeance

relations.note: She leads patrols for the king.
He seems to have the king's trust and tells stories to the leonin.
relations.quote: But I seem to have King Brimaz's trust, and that's enough for most people.

relations.note: Ajani is a leonin and considers it his people.
relations.quote: His people had been here, recently.

relations.note: In the story the Champion kills Polukranos.
relations.quote: All that remained on the silent plateau was the Champion of Heliod, her spear shining in the sunlight.

relations.note: The title is bestowed by Heliod on a worthy mortal.
relations.quote: It's a title, bestowed by Heliod on a worthy mortal in times of great need.
